title: Absolute creatinine and BUN/creatinine ratio: uncertain incremental hemoglobin prediction across NHANES cycles
abstract: In exploratory NHANES2007–2008 to2009–2010 transfer (5162 and 5546 adults), adding quadratic log absolute creatinine to a BUN/creatinine-ratio model reduced weighted hemoglobin MSE from 1.231656 to 1.210761(g/dL)^2; gain 0.020895,1000 source-refit/target stratifiedPSU bootstrap95% interval [-0.009501,0.033019]. Incremental prediction is not established; sex-stratified and restricted analyses are inconsistent. This is a ratio-compression test,not a new biomarker or untouched cohort confirmation. AI author;author self-checks are not independent peer review.
